item.title: Convalescent Plasma Restores Viral Clearance After Anti-Spike Monoclonal Antibody Failure in Immunocompromised COVID-19 Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Individual Patient Data.
武汉祖传多抗原严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2病毒样颗粒可预防omicron亚谱系JN.1变种
item.description: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)通过刺突蛋白(S)蛋白的突变持续进化,导致抗原性差异的变异株,如奥密克戎亚系JN.1,显著降低抗病毒药物诱导的中和抗体活性。这些局限性凸显了开发能够诱导多层保护性免疫而非仅依赖S蛋白靶向免疫的抗病毒药物策略的必要性。在此,我们利用杆状病毒双表达系统开发了一种基于武汉系的多抗原病毒样颗粒(VLP)疫苗,该疫苗整合了S、包膜(E)、膜(M)和核衣壳(N)蛋白。小鼠通过肌肉注射进行初次免疫,并通过肌肉注射或鼻腔途径进行加强免疫,评估了体液、黏膜和细胞免疫应答。两种加强方案均诱导了强效的全身IgG反应,而通过鼻腔加强则特异性增强了黏膜IgA反应。VLP免疫小鼠的血清能够有效中和同源武汉系毒株,但对JN.1变异株则未表现出可检测的中和活性。尽管如此,VLP免疫在肺部和全身均诱导了抗原特异性的CD4+和CD8+ T细胞反应。在高度易感的K18-hACE2小鼠模型中,VLP免疫完全防止了病毒在武汉系毒株和JN.1变异株挑战后的感染,并显著抑制了呼吸道组织中的病毒复制。组织病理学分析进一步显示,接种VLP的小鼠肺部仅有轻微的间质性肺病变,并伴有组织化的血管周围淋巴细胞浸润。肺部细胞因子分析还揭示了根据挑战毒株和免疫状态而定的免疫应答模式差异。我们的研究结果表明,基于武汉系的多抗原VLP疫苗能够提供对抗原性差异的变异株的交叉保护,这种保护不能仅通过可检测的血清中和活性来完全解释,提示了整合体液、细胞和局部免疫机制的重要性。

item.title: Timing, Titre, and Host Determinants of Convalescent Plasma Efficacy in COVID-19: A Systematic Review With Design-Stratified Narrative Synthesis.
绘制美国严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、流感和呼吸道合胞病毒监测数据基础设施图谱
item.description: 传染病监测构成公共卫生的流行病学基石,支撑健康数据的持续系统性收集与分析。然而,这些数据由碎片化的系统与实体网络收集,其可及性与高效利用受到复杂化影响。本综述描述了三种重要呼吸道病毒——流感、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)及严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2——的关键监测系统,突出这些系统的局限性,并识别改进机遇。高质量监测数据对有效公共卫生干预至关重要。美国公共卫生基础设施的分散性及由此形成的监测网络补丁式拼接,为试图动员这些数据用于疫情应对、政策评估或基于人群的研究的流行病学家带来了严峻挑战。明确这些关键监测系统、其收集的数据及所代表的人群,可支持其更有效地用于公共卫生研究与应急响应。我们识别出十三个在美国监测流感、RSV与严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的监测数据源;除一个外均为政府系统。其中多数(9个)为基于病例的系统,2个为综合性监测系统(监测人群中与疾病相关症状增加而非疾病本身),2个被归类为“非常规”数据源,如废水监测系统。我们还评估了这些系统及常向其提供数据的州与地方实体的数据相对可及性,并汇编信息以提升其可发现性与可及性。在线版本包含补充材料,可于10.1007/s40471-026-00405-w访问。

item.title: TRPV4介导的钙离子内流促进了温度依赖性严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2复制
item.description: 鼻腔、下呼吸道及发热状态下的温度各不相同,但这些差异对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2复制的影响尚未得到充分理解。本研究表明,祖系严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、Delta或Omicron BA.5变异株在37°C条件下复制效率最高。我们发现,瞬时受体电位香草酸受体4(TRPV4)介导的钙离子内流(一种在37°C被激活的热敏阳离子通道)有助于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的有效复制。此外,钙调磷酸酶抑制剂环孢素A(Cys A)及FDA批准的钙通道阻滞剂马尼地平均可抑制病毒复制,并保护叙利亚仓鼠免受严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 Delta变异株致死性感染。值得注意的是,选择性TRPV4拮抗剂也在感染仓鼠中提供了保护作用。这些结果表明,TRPV4介导的钙离子内流在37°C条件下促进了严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的有效复制,并凸显马尼地平作为抗严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2治疗药物再利用的强大候选。

深度测序严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2数据中人为假象及误导性宿主内变异株的识别与屏蔽
在气液界面人肺类器官芯片中重现严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2感染
item.description: 摘要 背景 慢性呼吸系统疾病及新发病原体(如严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)是全球主要的健康负担。然而,传统体外模型难以重现人肺的功能复杂性,限制了机制研究与治疗开发。方法 为解决这一问题,本研究构建了一种肺类器官芯片,其中患者来源的气道类器官在气液界面分化,并与微流控平台上的血管内皮细胞和巨噬细胞共培养。该芯片被用于感染四种严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株——原始株(Wuhan)、Delta、Omicron BA.1及Omicron XBB.1——并通过单细胞RNA测序进行表征。结果 该平台在气液界面重建了原生气道细胞组成,单细胞表征显示出显著的上皮重塑,包括纤毛细胞丢失、干扰素应答受抑以及部分上皮-间充质转化启动。同时伴随内皮细胞血管生成反应,表现为扩增的血管生成尖端样状态及血管内皮生长因子(VEGF)非依赖性血管生成配体程序,且上述反应在四种变异株中保持一致。结论 综合而言,该肺类器官芯片重现了保守的严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2上皮与血管反应,为呼吸系统疾病研究提供了一种生理相关的平台。

item.title: COVID-19 dashboard
item.description: The WHO COVID-19 dashboard provides a global summary of confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases and deaths, with data collected from countries, territories, and areas. It includes information on case definitions, testing strategies, and reporting practices, which vary by region. The dashboard has been updated since March 2020, with weekly data from July 2023 onwards. Data is subject to continuous verification and may change due to retrospective updates or shifts in reporting standards. WHO acknowledges that case detection, testing, and reporting practices differ globally, which can lead to under or overestimation of true case and death counts. Additionally, some countries have stopped reporting or changed their reporting frequency, which may affect the completeness of the data. The dashboard serves as a tool for monitoring the pandemic's spread and impact, but it is important to note that the data reflects official reports and may not capture all cases or deaths accurately.

item.title: 当前流行趋势(基于Rt值)| CFA:建模与预测 - 美国疾病控制与预防中心 | CDC (.gov)
item.description: 本文由美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)于2026年8月21日发布,讨论基于基本再生数(Rt)的当前流行趋势。文中包含关于多种暴发的一般信息,例如与苜蓿芽、墨西哥辣椒、带壳鸡蛋和结球莴苣相关的暴发,但未报告任何确诊或疑似严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2或相关变异株病例。内容强调CDC在提供公共卫生信息方面的作用,并提及其他暴发,如沙门氏菌病和环孢子虫病。然而,文中未提供与严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关的具体病例数、死亡数或风险等级。本文作为持续公共卫生监测的摘要,未详述与该病毒相关的具体应对措施或调查。

item.title: COVID-19 - Encyclopedia Britannica
item.description: The article from Encyclopedia Britannica, published on August 18, 2026, provides an overview of SARS-CoV-2, the virus responsible for the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights the virus's origin in Wuhan, China, in 2019, and its rapid global spread, leading to millions of deaths. The piece details transmission methods, such as respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces, and notes that older adults and individuals with chronic illnesses are at higher risk. It also discusses the development of vaccines and the implementation of preventive measures like social distancing and face masks. Additionally, the article touches on the political implications of the pandemic, including actions taken by a Senate committee against Anthony Fauci. The information is based on general knowledge and does not include specific case counts or detailed investigations, as it is an explanatory summary rather than a report of new events.

item.title: 522,000 COVID-19 Cases 'Explode' in China in One Month... Concerns Rising in Korea - 아시아경제
item.description: The news report highlights a significant surge in COVID-19 cases in China, with 522,000 reported from July 1 to 31, 2026, and a rising detection rate in South Korea. The dominant strain in China is the Omicron variant NB.1.8.1, while South Korea is primarily affected by BA.3.2. In China, the positivity rate among patients with influenza-like symptoms increased from 8.2% at the end of June to 21.2% by the end of July, indicating a potential resurgence. South Korea's detection rate for respiratory specimens rose to 9.1% in the third week of August, nearly 2.8 times higher than three weeks prior. Health authorities in South Korea are on high alert, and experts stress the importance of vaccine supply management and personal hygiene. The NB.1.8.1 variant has also been detected in South Korea, but the main strain remains BA.3.2. The report notes challenges in securing additional vaccine doses during outbreaks, citing recent shortages in Taiwan as an example. These developments underscore the need for continued monitoring and preparedness.

item.title: COVID-19 Resurges in China With 520,000 Cases in July; Korea's Detection Rate Triples - Seoul Economic Daily
item.description: China reported 522,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases in July 2026, with the Omicron subvariant NB.1.8.1 accounting for 99% of sequenced samples, while sentinel hospitals recorded a 21.2% test positivity rate among outpatients with respiratory symptoms by late July. South Korea’s COVID-19 detection rate tripled over three weeks, rising from 3.2% in late July to 9.1% in mid-August, amid regional spread. Authorities in both countries note the current wave is milder than earlier pandemic waves, but warn of possible summer resurgence and localized vaccine shortages. South Korea has secured 4.84 million vaccine doses and approved a new variant-targeting vaccine, prioritizing older adults and high-risk groups for free immunization.
